This is Midland Center for the Arts, a one-of-a-kind venue where all ages are invited to create as well as appreciate and explore a diverse array of guest artists, internationally known art and science exhibits, professional symphony concerts, award-winning theatre, art classes and more. Chippewa Nature Center Chippewa Nature Center is one of the largest private non-profit nature centers in the United States. Over 70,000 people visit CNC every year, including 1,000 Nature Day Campers and thousands of school children.
